title: BahnMining - Pünktlichkeit ist eine Zier (David Kriesel)
summary: David Kriesel's 36C3 talk, in German, analyzes a year of scraped data on every stop of every long-distance train in Germany. It shows how Deutsche Bahn delay statistics hide cancellations and delays.
why: Recommended in threads on German rail as the data-backed explanation of how reported punctuality understates real delays.

quote.text: there's the great talk from David Kriesel on the 36C3 [1] about how Deutsche Bahn is... "doing statistics" to hide their delays. It's well worth the hour!
